'''2024 Charity Paul Todd Feldman DS BHBM''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Todd Feldman]] at the [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Event:''' [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Classic (no v-cards)|Classic No-V]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]] · [[Twi'lek Advisor]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:2024-retro-24Retro Feldman DS BHBM.txt|Download]]
